scope: Native upstream hwpe_ctrl_partial_mult.sv, hwpe_ctrl_package.sv, and hwpe_ctrl_uloop.sv. Public baseline is unmodified upstream RTL.

tools.synthesis: Yosys 0.70+286 with Slang frontend and ABC technology mapping to NangateOpenCellLibrary_typical.lib
tools.sta: OpenROAD 26Q2 global placement (density 0.4, metal2/metal3 pins and RC) and placement-estimated parasitics at 3.1 ns clock period, 0.25 ns I/O delays, 5.0 fF output load

limitations: Cycle-accurate simulation across (32,32,4), (17,11,4), and (24,16,4) plus uloop stride integration, not unbounded formal equivalence. Nangate45 mapped standard-cell area and OpenROAD placement-estimated STA, not detailed routing or foundry signoff.
